create_trajectory_writer: create a TrajectoryWriter to write structured data to Reverb tables with automatic column tracking
append_trajectory_data: append structured data to the TrajectoryWriter with optional partial_step for multi-part steps
create_reverb_item: create an item in a Reverb table by referencing TrajectoryColumn objects from writer history
flush_pending_items: flush pending items to the Reverb server with configurable block_until_num_items and timeout
configure_chunker: configure chunking options for a specific column path with num_keep_alive_refs and max_chunk_length
